segments.title: THE DAY THE BRAIN CELL WENT LIVE

sources.text: braincell: deploy to Netlify, our-one-brain-cell.netlify.app (7 Oct 2026)
braincell v4b: the grader's findings fixed (7 Oct 2026)
braincell v4c: the re-grade's finding fixed (7 Oct 2026)
braincell: finished; the design mockups go, the tests stand without the gift notes (7 Oct 2026)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chiang Mai. The seventh of October. A single brain cell, built by one man, is about to meet the world.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: One brain cell. That is the whole name of the thing. I love it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before it could go live, a grader read the fourth version and found things to fix.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: He fixed them. Then a second grader read it again and found one more.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He fixed that one too. Version four, letter c. Then the deploy.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: A deploy at the end of a day like that feels like a door opening.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By nightfall the design mockups were gone and the tests stood on their own. He wrote one word in the log: finished.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Finished. Say it again, it sounds even better the second time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That was the seventh. The record is below. Nothing here was invented.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: And this is the stand-in voice. The real one comes later. Please forgive the beeps.
